text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

Panel composition alone tells you nothing. An all-women panel is statistically unremarkable in many ministries, and there's no evidence that same-sex panels favour their own sex — if anything, research on hiring panels finds weak and inconsistent effects. Raising it would shift attention from your strongest point to your weakest, and would read as an inference from sex alone.

Your real grievance is procedural: a legally required or expected written explanation is two weeks overdue. Chase that in writing, ask for the scoring against the published criteria, and ask how "leading international projects" was weighted. If the reasons turn out to be post-hoc or criteria shifted, you have something concrete. Judge the decision on the paperwork, not the panel's demographics.
